'''Alan Herbert Cowley ''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Jones|first1=Richard A.|last2=Kemp|first2=Richard A.|last3=Lasch|first3=Jonathan G.|last4=Lattman|first4=Michael|last5=Norman|first5=Nicholas C.|date=2021|title=Alan Herbert Cowley. 29 January 1934—2 August 2020|journal=Biographical Memoirs of Fellows of the Royal Society|volume=72|pages=139–160 |doi=10.1098/rsbm.2021.0027|s2cid=244923102|doi-access=free}}</ref> (29 January 1934 – 2 August 2020)<ref name=":0" /> was a British [[chemist]], and Robert A. Welch Chair at the [[University of Texas at Austin]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cm.utexas.edu/alan_cowley |title=Alan H. Cowley « University of Texas Chemistry Department |access-date=2011-12-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110812220741/http://www.cm.utexas.edu/alan_cowley |archive-date=2011-08-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.tmi.utexas.edu/Faculty/alan-h-cowley/ |title=Alan H. Cowley {{!}} Texas Materials Institute and Materials Science & Engineering at the University of Texas at Austin |website=www.tmi.utexas.edu |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120425062420/http://www.tmi.utexas.edu/Faculty/alan-h-cowley/ |archive-date=2012-04-25}} </ref> He was a 1976 [[Guggenheim Fellow]].

==Life==
He earned a BS in 1955, MS in 1956, and PhD in 1958, from [[University of Manchester]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Professor Emeritus Alan Cowley Has Passed Away|url=https://cm.utexas.edu/news/entry/professor-emeritus-alan-cowley-has-passed-away|access-date=2022-02-11|website=cm.utexas.edu|language=en-gb}}</ref> He taught at the University of Texas at Austin, from 1962 to 1998. He was the Sir Edward Frankland Professor of Inorganic Chemistry, at [[Imperial College, London]], from 1988 to 1989.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://cowley.cm.utexas.edu/acowley/Cowley.html |title=Cowley Group |website=cowley.cm.utexas.edu |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120426034737/http://cowley.cm.utexas.edu/acowley/Cowley.html |archive-date=2012-04-26}} </ref>

He died on 2 August 2020.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/austin-tx/alan-cowley-9296880|title=Alan Cowley Obituary - Austin, TX}}</ref>
